title: 第十章 一场误会误一生，世间再无王素仪
novel_title: 救命！我的神煞师父怎么天天亲我
content_zh:
那么多年过去，她已经流不出泪来了，只是满脸怨恨又藏着一丝期待地望着他。

    林大柄艰难地直起身来，抬头凝视着她。

    “我刚毕业那年，爸妈说你喜欢上了别人，那人很有钱，能给你更好的生活。你让他们带话给我，叫我别再回去找你，你不想被别人误会。”

    “得知消息以后，我把自己关在出租屋里，买了好几箱酒，喝了三天三夜，差点丢了性命，最后还是房东发现，才把我送进医院。”

    “但我没有放弃，我知道你还没有嫁人，我拼了命的工作，想着只要能攒够钱，也能给你更好的生活，那样你或许还是会选择我。”

    “可我没能等到攒够钱娶你的那天，只等来了警察，他们在这里发现了你的尸体，你身上，就只有一张写着我住址的纸条。”

    “都怪我……我不该因为几句话就轻信了他们，我应该来找你，听你亲口告诉我，可我始终不敢，我不敢面对……是我对不起你，素仪……”

    林大柄说完，把头埋在地上，哭得浑身颤抖。

    王素仪愣怔在原地，鬼气飘忽不定。

    鬼气最终渐渐归于平静，王素仪轻轻扶起林大柄，抬手捧着他的脸，指尖抚过他脸颊的泪痕。

    “柄哥，我不怪你了……要怪，就只能怪我们这辈子，终究是……有缘无份。”

    姜无念察觉到王素仪周身戾气骤减，站起身来拍了拍衣摆，对身旁的虚白说道：“走吧，成了！”

    她还是看不明白到底是为了什么，竟值得这几十年的执念，还让这么多无辜人给他们陪葬。

    王素仪和林大柄两人又说了许多话，直到她察觉到自身鬼气开始侵蚀林大柄的身体，这才依依不舍地退开，来到姜无念面前。

    林大柄不知道她为什么突然离开，也跟着她走了过来。

    “柄哥，你别靠得太近，我会伤害到你。”

    “素仪，我不怕！”

    林大柄还想上前，却在王素仪的眼神哀求下止了脚步。

    王素仪在姜无念面前跪下，恭恭敬敬地磕了一个头，轻声开口：

    “我知道自己害人无数，罪孽深重，大师能将我留到现在，我已经非常感激，自愿接受您的任何处置。”

    林大柄见到王素仪如此对待姜无念，再看向虚白也是一脸恭敬，眼神满是震撼，没想到这偶然救下的女孩，竟是个“大师”。
content_en:
After so many years, she could no longer shed tears. She could only look at him with resentment and a hint of expectation hidden in her face.

    Lin Dabiang straightened up with difficulty and stared up at her.

    "When I first graduated, my parents said that you fell in love with someone else. That person was very rich and could give you a better life. You asked them to give me a message and told me not to go back to you again. You didn't want to be misunderstood by others."

    "After I learned the news, I locked myself in a rental house, bought several boxes of wine, and drank for three days and three nights. I almost lost my life. In the end, the landlord found out and sent me to the hospital."

    "But I didn't give up. I knew you weren't married yet. I worked hard, thinking that as long as I could save enough money, I could give you a better life. In that case, you might still choose me."

    "But I didn't wait until the day I saved up enough money to marry you. I just waited until the police came. They found your body here. There was only a piece of paper with my address on it."

    "It's all my fault... I shouldn't have believed them just because of a few words. I should have come to you and heard you tell me personally, but I still dare not, I dare not face it... I am the one who is sorry for you, Suyi..."

    After Lin Daying finished speaking, he buried his head on the ground and cried so hard that his whole body was shaking.

    Wang Suyi froze on the spot, her ghostly aura erratic.

    The ghostly aura finally calmed down. Wang Suyi gently helped Lin Dabeng, raised her hand to hold his face, and touched the tear stains on his cheek with her fingertips.

    "Brother Bing, I don't blame you anymore... If I want to blame you, I can only blame us in this life. After all, we are... destined but not destined."

    Jiang Wunian noticed that Wang Suyi's aura of hostility dropped sharply. He stood up, patted the hem of his clothes, and said to Xu Bai beside him, "Let's go, it's done!"

    She still couldn't understand why it was worth these decades of obsession and allowing so many innocent people to be buried with them.

    Wang Suyi and Lin Daying talked for a lot more, until she noticed that her ghost energy was beginning to corrode Lin Daying's body, and then she reluctantly stepped away and came to Jiang Wunian.

    Lin Daying didn't know why she left suddenly, so he followed her.

    "Brother Bing, don't get too close, I will hurt you."

    "Suyi, I'm not afraid!"

    Lin Daying wanted to step forward, but stopped under Wang Suyi's pleading eyes.

    Wang Suyi knelt down in front of Jiang Wunian, kowtowed respectfully, and spoke softly:

    "I know that I have harmed countless people and my sins are serious. I am very grateful that Master can keep me until now, and I will voluntarily accept any disposal you have."

    When Lin Dabing saw Wang Suyi treating Jiang Wunian like this, he looked at Xubai with respect and his eyes were full of shock. He didn't expect that the girl he accidentally saved was a "master".
title_en: Chapter 10 A misunderstanding ruined a life, there will be no more Wang Suyi in the world
